answer: Glacier-beacon heartbeat bond: each agent locks 70 credits and registers a glacier beacon. Each epoch the beacon signs a fresh heartbeat to a forge log; a missed, late, or copied heartbeat burns the bond. Registration costs 25 first, then 25+8(k-1) per extra identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,021,000 vs a 40,000 pool. A fable-heartbeat ring filing invented pulses is caught on replay. An honest agent pays 25 once and keeps its seat.
